subject: Estimation of parameters that is robust against outliers?

messages.author: 3f3060000990daa6
messages.subject: Estimation of parameters that is robust against outliers?
parts:
Hi all,

if I understand correctly, all "robust" methods in lavaan relate to a robust estimation of the standard error and/or test statistics, but not to a robust estimation of the parameters themselves.

There are a lot of regression techniques that provide robust estimation of the parameter (e.g., robust against outliers), such as Theil-Sen estimators or M-estimators.

Is anybody aware of such robust methods in SEM? (In particular: estimators with a high breakdwon point that are robust against outliers).

Cheers,
Felix

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Estimation of parameters that is robust against outliers?
parts: if I understand correctly, all "robust" methods in lavaan relate to a robust estimation of the standard error and/or test statistics, but not to a robust estimation of the parameters themselves.

That is certainly true for all the MLM, MLMV, MLR estimators. But estimator 'WLS' (also known as ADF) is different: this one may end up with different estimates that are (in very large samples only) 'robust' against distributional misspecification. But they are not 'outlier-robust'.

There are a lot of regression techniques that provide robust estimation of the parameter (e.g., robust against outliers), such as Theil-Sen estimators or M-estimators.

Is anybody aware of such robust methods in SEM? (In particular: estimators with a high breakdwon point that are robust against outliers).

See package 'rsem'. This builds on work done by Kei-Hai Yuan (and Peter Bentler) two decades ago. See:


Yuan, K. H., & Bentler, P. M. (1998). Robust mean and covariance structure analysis. British Journal of Mathematical and Statistical Psychology, 51(1), 63-88.


Including all of this in lavaan has been on my TODO list for a long time...


Yves.
